mentions.name: SCComps.com (Speed Cubing Competitions listing app)
mentions.description: iOS app built in Flutter that lists speed cubing competitions, letting cubers browse upcoming events. It has around 250 downloads, generates no revenue, and costs about $500 a year to keep running; the author is deciding whether to rebuild it in Swift or shut it down.
mentions.problem: Generates no revenue, costs roughly $500 a year to keep running, and has little community engagement, prompting a decision between a Swift rebuild and shutting down.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m at a crossroads with my Speed Cubing Competitions listing app (SCComps.com). It’s an iOS app built in Flutter, has around 250 downloads, and currently generates no revenue. I'm spending about $500 a year just to keep it running. There’s little community engagement, and I'm debating whether to double down and rebuild it in Swift—or just shut it down altogether.
